body:
As mentioned in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/99128#issuecomment-2993836463, we originally closed this PR because we thought another PR fixed the issue and seemed less risky. Since then, multiple users have told us in the issue that they can still reproduce it, and have confirmed that this PR fixes it.

The PR has been rebased and the code looks good to me. Given we're still in the 4.5 beta phase, I think we can merge it and have time to revert if any issues arise.

Thanks for your contribution and your patience!
